# ia-vscode

ItemsAdder configurations intellisense for VisualStudio Code.

## Compatibility

Supports ItemsAdder 4.0.18, 4.0.19 and 4.1.0 configuration fields. Main plugin configs are detected by `resource-pack.uuid` (legacy) or `pack_delivery.uuid` (modern), with matching completion, hover and validation.
